notes.title: A NEW Alien Tag Update just released...
notes.notes:
Alien Tag's FIRST Buyable Cosmetic is OUT NOW! THE SUNGLASSES FROM THE FUTURE!!!!! GO UPDATE UR GAME AND BUY EM NOW! 

The main changed are listed below 👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇

- Added Sunglasses From The Future 

- New INSANE Color Selector where you can select ANY COLOR in the world, not just 8 colors like before (gtag JUST updated their color selector after 3 years and it still isn't as simple and easy to use as ours)

- New Lobby Settings allows the Host to change the Map, Gamemode, Lobby Type & set the lobby to Public or Private without having to make a new lobby

- Custom Maps no longer require an email to use and you can switch between maps much easier

- New Updated Lobby Browser where you can view open lobby's to join 

- If your hands/controllers weren't working when launching the game and stuck in place, that bug is now fixed :)

p.s. if you are encountering a bug where your cursor when using the menu is very jittery and moving up and down super fast, try taking your hand off the ground and just "sitting" without using your hands to stand up. this should make your cursor stop jittering.
